chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man about 25 with short curly black hair and a light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman about 28 wearing an emerald-green satin hijab and a long cream abaya with gold trim
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan man about 32 with a neat beard and glasses, wearing a burgundy polo shirt and beige chinos
chars.KID: a Moroccan boy about 8 wearing a red football jersey and blue shorts

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Bright modern Moroccan apartment entrance. WIFE stands firmly in the living room with arms crossed, shaking her head with a sly half-smile, refusing to leave; BROTHER at the open front door, car keys in hand, looks at her surprised. 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan home kitchen with tiled walls and a tagine on the stove. WIFE stirs a pot, glancing sideways with a mysterious smile; KID tugs her sleeve asking to come along. 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Street outside a Moroccan apartment building. BROTHER cheerfully pulls a sleepy, tired NARRATOR by the arm toward a parked car; NARRATOR yawns, dragging his feet. 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Busy Moroccan city square with palm trees, cafes and a minaret in the background. BROTHER points around excitedly, KID runs ahead happily, NARRATOR walks behind bored with hands in hoodie pocket. 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room with low sofas, family eating lunch around a round table with a big tagine. WIFE serves food and secretly winks toward NARRATOR, who freezes mid-bite, confused; BROTHER eats without noticing. 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Quiet Moroccan apartment hallway in afternoon light. NARRATOR stands alone looking left and right, puzzled, the house silent and empty, shoes missing from the shoe rack. 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon with patterned cushions and a brass tea tray. WIFE sits on the sofa, waving hello with a big playful smile; NARRATOR stops in the doorway, surprised, eyebrows raised. 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. WIFE leans forward on the sofa, gesturing toward the window as if saying everyone left, smiling mischievously; NARRATOR stands awkwardly scratching the back of his head. 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon, close medium shot. WIFE laughs playfully covering her mouth with her hand; NARRATOR looks at the camera with wide panicked eyes, sweat drop on his forehead, comedic awkward tension. 2D cartoon style.
